businessesSubtitle: Delve into our synergistic operations, delivering value and promoting sustainability across diverse agri-industrial sectors.
businessSugarDetails: Our state-of-the-art automated milling process has an 8,000 TCD capacity, producing high-quality refined sugar with industry-leading efficiency. We serve a broad range of industrial and retail clients, ensuring purity and consistency in every batch. Crucially, our sugar operations form the backbone of a circular model—key byproducts like molasses and bagasse feed into our ethanol and power generation units, minimizing waste and maximizing value.
businessEthanolDetails: Leading biofuel production with 350 KLPD capacity. Our fuel-grade ethanol meets stringent quality standards, contributing significantly to cleaner energy solutions.
businessPowerDetails: Our 35 MW cogeneration power plant exemplifies renewable energy commitment. We utilize bagasse for sustainable electricity, exporting 14 MW to the grid, powering communities and industries alike.
businessFeedDetails: Producing 200 TPD of premium Distillers Dried Grains with Solubles (DDGS). Our Narsingh Gold & Silver brands offer highly nutritious and protein-rich feed for livestock and poultry sectors.
businessOrganicManureDetails: Through our bio-composting initiative, we convert sugar press mud and distillery spent wash into organic manure. This eco-friendly fertilizer enriches the soil for local farmers and closes the loop in our production cycle, exemplifying our zero-waste philosophy.

aboutLeadershipSubtitle: Experienced leadership driving our vision forward
aboutFounderBio: Mr. Nawab Raza exchanged the badge for a dream. After two decades dedicated to protecting his nation, a fascination with sugar manufacturing ignited a new purpose. In 2005, he laid the foundation for Mahakaushal Sugar and Power Industries Ltd., pioneering the sugar industry in his native Madhya Pradesh. Starting with nothing but unwavering determination, Nawab Raza immersed himself in the intricacies of sugar production. He forged unbreakable bonds with local farmers, recognizing their potential as the backbone of his vision. Through sheer grit and an unyielding commitment, he transformed a nascent idea into a thriving enterprise. Nawab Raza's legacy is more than just a company; it's a testament to the power of human spirit and the transformative impact of perseverance. His journey has not only propelled our growth but has also elevated the economic landscape of the region.
aboutMDBio: With over 10 years of experience across multiple sectors, including pharmaceuticals, IT, and sugar, he has previously worked with various companies such as Al-Raafi (Zambia), SKYRAS, and RCC Fabricators Ltd. He holds an MS in Mechanical Engineering from Arizona State University (ASU), is highly technically driven, and is a member of GEMA (Grain Ethanol Manufacturers Association).
aboutDirectorBio: He has over 10 years of experience in supply chain management and holds a Master's degree in International Management. His career includes work with ThyssenKrupp's submarine division in Germany, where he gained expertise in strategic planning, procurement, and optimizing supply chain efficiencies.
aboutDirector2Bio: Mr. Asad Raza is a seasoned operations specialist with extensive expertise in manufacturing excellence and process optimization across multiple industries. His operational leadership has been instrumental in achieving consistent production targets and maintaining high-quality standards across all business verticals. He oversees daily operations of the sugar mill, ethanol distillery, and co-generation power plant, ensuring seamless coordination between different production units. His focus on lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement has resulted in significant cost reductions and efficiency gains. He has implemented advanced process control systems and quality management protocols that ensure product consistency and regulatory compliance. His expertise in maintenance management and asset optimization has maximized equipment uptime and extended machinery lifespan. Under his leadership, the company has achieved industry-leading safety records and operational efficiency metrics.
aboutDirector3Bio: Mr. Ahmed Raza is a strategic finance professional with deep expertise in corporate finance, investment analysis, and long-term strategic planning. His financial acumen has been crucial in securing funding for major expansion projects and optimizing capital allocation across business verticals. He oversees financial planning and analysis, risk management, and investor relations, ensuring transparent communication with stakeholders and regulatory compliance. His strategic insights have guided the company's diversification into ethanol production and renewable energy, identifying new growth opportunities and market trends. He has established robust financial controls and reporting systems that provide real-time visibility into business performance. His expertise in project finance and capital markets has enabled successful fundraising for expansion initiatives. He actively monitors industry benchmarks and competitive dynamics to inform strategic decision-making and maintain MSPIL's competitive advantage in the market.
aboutDirector4Bio: Ms. Fatima Raza is a dynamic HR leader with extensive experience in talent development, organizational excellence, and cultural transformation. Her people-centric approach has been instrumental in building a high-performance culture and attracting top talent across all business functions. She oversees talent acquisition, performance management, leadership development, and employee engagement initiatives. Her focus on diversity and inclusion has created an inclusive workplace that values different perspectives and backgrounds. She has implemented comprehensive training and development programs that enhance employee skills and career progression opportunities. Her expertise in organizational design and change management has supported the company's growth and transformation initiatives. She champions employee welfare programs, safety initiatives, and work-life balance policies that have resulted in high employee satisfaction and retention rates. Her strategic HR initiatives align with business objectives and contribute to sustainable organizational growth.
aboutBoardSubtitle: Independent board members providing strategic guidance and governance oversight
aboutBoard1Bio: Education - IIT - Delhi. Experience: Managing Director, Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL): Mr. Ranganathan significantly expanded IGL's city gas distribution network, introducing innovative solutions to ensure energy efficiency and regulatory compliance in urban energy distribution. Contribution - Mr. Ranganathan can play a crucial role in setting up the distribution network for ethanol, similar to his successful model with natural gas. Leveraging his knowledge of logistics, regulatory frameworks, and infrastructure, he can ensure efficient and cost-effective transport of ethanol from production sites to markets. His experience with government and public policy will also ensure compliance with all regulations, facilitating smoother operations and faster market access.
aboutBoard2Bio: Education - IIT - Delhi. Experience: Ex Chairman & Managing Director, IRCON International Limited (2009–2016): Chairman & Managing Director, IRCON International Limited (2009–2016). Contribution - Mr. Tiwari will bring his logistical expertise to oversee the development of the country's first ethanol supply chain via rail, optimizing loading facilities and ensuring smooth interstate transportation. Mr. Tiwari's extensive experience in rail logistics makes him an ideal leader to spearhead India's first ethanol supply chain through train loading.
aboutBoard3Bio: With over 15 years of experience in pharmaceutical biotechnology and public health, including roles at the UNOPS and WHO, Dr. Dubey brings exceptional expertise to our team. He has managed significant programs with budgets over $50 million and launched innovative products across various global markets. Dr. Dubey's extensive background in therapeutic areas and commercialization of treatments aligns perfectly with our goals. His MD in Preventive and Social Medicine, MPH from the Indian Institute of Public Health, and specialized training from UC San Diego further enhance his strategic insight.
aboutBoard4Bio: Education - Ph.D. in Animal Nutrition. Experience: Dr. Chandrakant N. Patil is a distinguished expert in animal nutrition with over two decades of experience in optimizing livestock feed, enhancing productivity, and leading research into natural feed supplements. Contribution - Dr. Patil's vast experience in developing innovative feed solutions, particularly those focusing on sustainability and resource optimization, is directly applicable to the ethanol business, where co-products like Distillers Dried Grains with Solubles (DDGS) from ethanol production play a critical role. His research in alternative feed sources aligns with maximizing the value of ethanol co-products for livestock feed, enhancing both profitability and sustainability for Mahakaushal.
